from.place: Proof paragraph 1, “The periodic resolution”: exactness of the alternating generator-minus-one/norm complex and its cochain computation of cyclic-group cohomology.

title: Periodic resolution of a finite cyclic group
statement: Let $m\geq1$, let $C_m=\langle\sigma\rangle$ be cyclic of order $m$, and let $P(m)$ be the augmented chain complex [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] of left $\mathbf Z[C_m]$-modules with $P(m)_s=\mathbf Z[C_m]$ in every degree $s\geq0$, differential multiplication by $\sigma-1$ from odd degree to the preceding even degree, differential multiplication by $N_m=1+\sigma+\cdots+\sigma^{m-1}$ from positive even degree to the preceding odd degree, and augmentation given by the sum of coefficients. A projective resolution here means an exact augmented nonnegative chain complex whose terms have the lifting property for surjective module homomorphisms. Then $P(m)\to\mathbf Z$ is a projective resolution of the trivial $\mathbf Z[C_m]$-module. For every left $\mathbf Z[C_m]$-module $M$, applying $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbf Z[C_m]}(-,M)$ identifies its cochain complex with $0\to M\xrightarrow{\sigma-1}M\xrightarrow{N_m}M\xrightarrow{\sigma-1}\cdots$, by evaluation at $1\in C_m$, and this complex computes $H^s(C_m,M)$ in every degree. Here $H^s(G,M)$ denotes the cohomology of functions $G^q\to M$ with differential $(da)(g_1,\ldots,g_{q+1})=g_1a(g_2,\ldots,g_{q+1})+\sum_{j=1}^{q}(-1)^ja(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{q+1})+(-1)^{q+1}a(g_1,\ldots,g_q)$.
